summary: Canadian Solar Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on June 30, 2026. The filing includes a press release and report of voting results, confirming that all proposals were approved by shareholders: the election of seven directors and the re-appointment of Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu as auditors. No transaction, special event, or strategic change is disclosed. The filing is a routine annual meeting disclosure with no special-situation elements. Therefore, it does not require further analysis or risk-arb angle.
